awakened1.name: ASHES
awakened1.text: Immune to suffocation, fatigue, and unconsciousness. You cannot sleep or dream, and need no food or water. While perfectly motionless you are indistinguishable from an inanimate cadaver.

awakened2.name: BONES
awakened2.text: As a 1-segment action, spend 1 charge to heal 1 BODY, 1 MIND, and 1 WILL.
